# 📚 Tutorial Review

## Tutorial metadata

- Title:
- Author:
- Reviewer:
- Version / commit:
- Target audience:
- Last verified date:

## Accuracy and reproducibility

- [ ] Commands match the package manifest.
- [ ] Installation uses the committed lockfile.
- [ ] Node.js and npm requirements are stated.
- [ ] File paths and component names exist.
- [ ] Example prompts match actual configured behavior.
- [ ] Screenshots or diagrams are labelled accurately.
- [ ] No fabricated output, metrics, or capabilities appear.

## Learning quality

- [ ] Objective is stated.
- [ ] Prerequisites are clear.
- [ ] Steps are complete and ordered.
- [ ] Each step explains the expected observation.
- [ ] Important terms are defined.
- [ ] Common errors and recovery steps are included.

## Product transparency

- [ ] The app is described as a scripted local demo.
- [ ] No LLM, API, database, or persistence feature is implied.
- [ ] Privacy and external font requests are explained accurately.
- [ ] Limitations are visible before learners rely on the app.

## Accessibility and maintenance

- [ ] Headings are hierarchical.
- [ ] Links have meaningful text.
- [ ] Images have useful alternative text.
- [ ] Code blocks specify language.
- [ ] Internal links resolve.
- [ ] Owner and next review date are recorded.

## Findings and decision

Record required corrections, severity, owner, due date, and approval status.
